name: HFWA United States Championship
epitaph: Mr. Nice Guy crowned the first named champion, defeating the Great Muta on the fed's own 17 July 1997 card.

name: HFWA Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Docta Devistate wins a same-card tournament (over King Thunder, then the Great Muta in the final) on the fed's own 17 July 1997 card.
